name: Vane's writ
description: A Court release writ over the signature of H. Vane, chair of the Council of Briar Glen. A donation of one hundred crowns to the bridge fund is receipted on the back.
notes: mw-m97i: bought from Vane for 100 crowns (vane-bounty writ-signed-fx); presented to Cray, who takes it (cray-customs). Quest item: noSell, noDrop. Value 100 is what it cost; owner to confirm.
